items.prompt: True or false: A half turn is the same as two quarter turns.
hints: Together they make a half turn.
items.explanation: A quarter turn plus a quarter turn is a half turn.

items.prompt: True or false: After a whole turn you face the opposite way.
hints: How far round is a whole turn?
Do you end up where you began?
items.explanation: A whole turn takes you all the way round to where you started. A half turn makes you face the opposite way.
